DRAFT · for the Chief of Staff · not sent · Note 7, after Note 5 
From: Jonathan Paul Zschoche, attorney-in-fact of Patricia Keesey Zschoche 
To: Atty. Bonifacio T. Barandon, Jr. 
Date: ____ October 2026 
Re: Civil Case No. 26-360, the records we would like subpoenaed, in the order you prefer

Atty. Barandon,

Following your reply that subpoenas should issue once our witnesses and exhibits are in, or on rebuttal, here is the list in that order. The draft request for your signature, with the full descriptions, is the one I sent earlier (item numbers below match it, (a) to (j), with one item added).

- **Before we rest (returnable 2 or 9 December), only if certified copies have not arrived:** the Registry file on the partition and the notarial registers. I requested certified copies of both by letter on 20 October; if they arrive, no subpoena is needed. The DENR survey file is in Legazpi, over 100 km away, so I will get the certified copy there myself (Rule 21 §10).

- **On rebuttal:** the prosecutor's file, the barangay blotter, the court records of the King cases, and the improvements records (permits, assessor, electric connection).

- **For the defense witness Salvador de la Fuente, returnable at his cross:** the receipt booklets behind their Exhibit 5, the Llamanzares papers he says he and his father collected in 1992, and any Violeta ledger.

Any record not pre-marked will need the court's leave; please tell me whether the Pre-Trial Order reserves additional documents.

**What I need from you:** (1) your choice of tier for each item (the table below has my suggestion); (2) whether to add item (k), the Salvador subpoena, to the request now or file it separately in January.

With respect, 
Jonathan Paul Zschoche
